# Vendored files

`drawio-viewer.js` is `viewer-static.min.js` from draw.io 32.6.10 (https://viewer.diagrams.net/js/viewer-static.min.js), under the Apache License 2.0 (https://github.com/jgraph/drawio/blob/dev/LICENSE). The viewer uses it to show a node's `docs/map.drawio`. It is not in npm, so it is kept here.
